_note: Treasure chests (the 12 originals live in code and are untouched). Edit freely: id, x, z, y (floor height, checked with spawnY), yaw, loot (e.g. kr45, snow12, thermos, flare3, rocket3, blue2, gold1, hint:text, item:name|text, or an array of these, or "random" = roll from data/loot_tables.json by tier, once per player), tier (common|uncommon|rare|sky), day (optional unlock day), secret + clue (book:<varde id> or find:<trail find id>; secret chests only show on the big map once the clue is found), near/area/note (text), oren (ignored for now). Keep 40 m between chests. NEW (loot job): ids lt_* are the extra chests and crates (table = chest|crate|summit|cave decides the loot, see data/loot_tables.json "tables"; crate:true = lighter wood).
